title: How AI CAD Agents Actually Reason in 3D #shorts
description:
Think AI CAD agents just imagine shapes? Think again. Unlike generative art, mechanical engineering requires precision that only programmatic code can provide. 

In this breakdown, we look at how new engines like Adam (YC W25) use geometric reasoning loops to design, compile, and debug physical parts in real-time. 

Subscribe for more deep dives into the future of software engineering and AI agents.

#AICAD #Engineering #SoftwareEngineering #AIAgents #MechanicalEngineering #techtrends
